governance.rule: Only promoted variables may carry non-zero decision weight. Experimental and validated variables remain evidence-only until a documented promotion decision.
promotionRequirements: no double counting with existing pillars

variables.name: CIAR analyst consensus
variables.description: Aggregated analyst distribution, consensus score, bullish share and net rating change.

variables.name: Daily Strategic Briefing tactical view
variables.description: Ticker-specific AGCI classification, thesis, confidence and catalysts when published.

variables.name: AGCI macro risk regime
variables.source: AGCI macro layer / Cboe / BIS / World Bank
variables.description: VIX regime, policy-rate context and briefing-level macro risk used for execution discipline.

variables.name: Insider buying / selling
variables.description: Future variable for material insider transactions after issuer-role normalization.

variables.name: Options flow / skew
variables.description: Future derivative positioning signal; never inferred from unverified social data.

variables.name: Issuer credit spreads
variables.description: Future credit-risk confirmation for levered issuers and cyclical names.

variables.name: Earnings transcript change detection
variables.confidencePolicy: requires cited text and change baseline
variables.description: Experimental detection of material changes in guidance, demand, margin and risk language.

variables.name: Institutional ownership / flow change
variables.description: Future slow-moving institutional ownership context; not treated as a timing signal.
